items.title: Analysis: Volkswagen-Gotion standoff highlights China's growing leverage in EV batteries
items.summary: Unlike China's automakers—whose supply chains operate with the flexibility and rapid iteration more commonly associated with the consumer electronics and ICT industries—automakers in Europe, the US, Japan, and South Korea have traditionally maintained strong bargaining power over critical components through rigorous contracts and tightly controlled supply chain management. items.title: Transcend warns memory shortage could extend through 2027
items.summary: Transcend Information said the global memory shortage remained severe and could persist through 2027, with little sign of improvement in 2026. The Taiwanese storage maker said upstream suppliers had warned that supply in 2027 could be even tighter than in 2026, keeping price increases in place for an extended period.

items.title: Taiwan business optimism eases in the third quarter as supply chains soften
items.summary: Dun & Bradstreet said Taiwan business confidence slipped slightly in the third quarter of 2026, with its Taiwan Business Optimism Insights survey measuring an overall index of 107. The reading was down 0.8% from the previous quarter but remained 4.5% higher than a year earlier, pointing to a modest cooldown rather than a broad decline.

items.title: Metaage 1H26 profit surges 330% on AI-driven enterprise demand

items.title: V5 July revenue reaches NT$273 million on AI chip demand, packaging expansion
